flowchart.title: JSON XML compare architecture
flowchart.code:
flowchart TB subgraph IN["inputs"] J[deal.json] X[deal.xml] M[mapping.yaml] CLI["CompareJsonXml.java run()"] end
CLI --> Pairs["JSON/XML pairs\n--json/--xml | --batch-dir | --manifest"] M --> MapL["MappingLoader.java"] Pairs --> Pair["CompareJsonXml.java runPair()"] MapL --> Pair
Pair --> ParseJ["ObjectMapper.readTree\ndeal.json"] Pair --> ParseX["DocumentBuilder.parse\ndeal.xml"]
ParseJ --> TreeJ[JsonNode jsonRoot] ParseX --> TreeX[Element xmlRoot] TreeJ --> Eng[Engine.java compareDocuments] TreeX --> Eng MapL --> Eng

Eng --> F Eng --> C
Rows --> Rpt[Reports.java writeAll] Rpt --> HTML[report.html] Rpt --> CSV[report.csv] Rpt --> JSON[report.json] Rpt -.-> IDX["batch: index.html"]

sequence.title: JSON XML compare sequence
sequence.code:
sequenceDiagram autonumber actor User participant CLI as CompareJsonXml.java
run() participant MapL as MappingLoader.java participant MapF as mapping.yaml participant JSON as deal.json participant XML as deal.xml participant Pair as CompareJsonXml.java
runPair() participant Eng as Engine.java participant Paths as Paths.java participant St as Status.java participant Row as Row.java participant Rpt as Reports.java User->>CLI: java -jar json-xml-compare.jar
--json deal.json --xml deal.xml
--mapping mapping.yaml --out report.html CLI->>CLI: Cli.parse() (or batch-dir / manifest CSV) CLI->>MapL: MappingLoader.load(mapping.yaml) MapL->>MapF: Files.readAllBytes + SnakeYAML MapF-->>MapL: JsonNode MapL->>MapL: validate() MapL-->>CLI: mapping CLI->>Pair: runPair(json, xml, out, mapping, name) Pair->>JSON: ObjectMapper.readTree() JSON-->>Pair: JsonNode jsonRoot Pair->>XML: DocumentBuilder.parse() XML-->>Pair: Element xmlRoot Pair->>Eng: Engine.compareDocuments(jsonRoot, xmlRoot, mapping) loop mapping.fields[] Eng->>Paths: Paths.jsonValue(jsonRoot, field.json) Paths-->>Eng: jsonData, usedJsonPath Eng->>Paths: Paths.xmlValue(xmlRoot, field.xml) Paths-->>Eng: xmlData, usedXmlPath Eng->>Eng: Engine.compare(field, json, xml, enums) Note over Eng,St: type / enum / tolerance
MATCH MISMATCH MISSING_* ID_PAIR Eng->>Row: new Row(...) end loop mapping.collections[] Eng->>Paths: Paths.jsonValues(collection.json) Eng->>Paths: Paths.xmlElements(collection.xml) Note over Eng: index by join.json / join.xml
never by array position alt key only on one side Eng->>Row: UNMATCHED_JSON_ROW / UNMATCHED_XML_ROW else keys match Eng->>Row: MATCH joined loop collection.fields[] Eng->>Paths: extract relative to row Eng->>Eng: Engine.compare(...) Eng->>Row: new Row(...) end end end Eng-->>Pair: List of Row Pair->>Rpt: Reports.writeAll(rows, report.html, metadata) Rpt-->>User: report.html Rpt-->>User: report.csv Rpt-->>User: report.json opt --batch-dir or --manifest CLI->>Rpt: Reports.writeBatchIndex() Rpt-->>User: out-dir/index.html end
